run: Run 16 to 17 November 2026 (2 hours) on a 32-core AMD EPYC-Milan Linux machine with 125 GB memory, R 4.6.1. laridae ca6770f (CGAL 6.1), cdtr 1b52f51 (0.1.0.9002), trowel 32e0fe8 (spade 2.15), RTriangle 1.6-0.15, trianglewins 00e51c5. Jobs ran one at a time with a 900 s timeout and a 12 GB address-space cap, as in the run of 6 October 2026, which was on a 4-core Intel Xeon container (its results are in the git history of bench/results/), so times are not directly comparable between the two. laridae's world insert_1k, which failed under the cap, was re-run alone with a 16 GB cap: bench/results/world-laridae-insert-16gb.csv.
